title: Vampire Vape Koncept Catapult E-Liquid Short Fill 50ml
description: Catapult launches your senses into the stratosphere with an intoxicating medley of sweet, sharp and juicy blackcurrants and a cooling rush of menthol. A deep, delicious, tropical aftertaste brings you down to earth, only to go on the ride again moments later. These short fill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml short fill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure you shake the contents of the short fill bottle well.
